Coverage describes the selected population. Converted tasks have passed format conversion, before curation admission. Training and evaluation use remain separate. Counts include repeated task instances; each task may appear in several curriculum rollups.

Similarity is a retrieval score. A broad subject match can remain useful when the nearest capability is weak. Inspect sampled instructions, embedding text and alternatives. The release uses fixed score cutoffs; these do not change curation decisions.
